typography.guidelines: Use Cormorant Garamond for all primary headings to establish an editorial, luxury magazine feel. Use Outfit for body and UI elements for readability and warmth. Never use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.

colors.guidelines: Avoid generic pink gradients entirely. Rely on solid colors and organic textures. Use Deep Coral as a distinct, deliberate highlight. Espresso replaces pure black for a softer, highly luxurious contrast.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Diffuse, ambient shadows only on interactive elements (e.g. shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(181,58,38,0.08)]). Most containers should be flat or use a delicate 1px border.
visual_enhancers.borders: Delicate 1px borders using coral/20 or gold/30. Avoid thick borders or standard gray outlines.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate a subtle SVG noise filter overlay across the background for an earthy, printed editorial paper feel.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: For floating elements (sticky header, booking modal), use high-saturation crystal glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#FAF9F6]/80 with a 1px solid border-white/60. CRITICAL: Do not use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays.

grids.editorial_bento: Use asymmetric layouts. E.g. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with items spanning 4 and 8 columns to break rigid symmetry.
grids.service_list: Use wide list-style layouts with generous padding (py-8) and a delicate bottom border rather than blocky boxed cards.
grids.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: p-8, p-12, p-24. Elements must have significant breathing room. Never cramp content.

layouts.hero: Full height (min-h-[90vh]) with a large editorial photograph offset to the right, overlapping with a massive serif headline on the left. Use a subtle gradient overlay ONLY if text sits directly on the image.
layouts.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header with logo centered, nav links flanking or aligned left, and a primary CTA 'Book Appointment' on the right.
layouts.footer: Massive padding (py-24). Deep espresso background with cream text. Huge 'RED CORAL' text/logo at the bottom acting as structural art.

motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling (e.g. via Lenis) is mandatory to create a premium feel.
motion.animations: Framer Motion for reveal animations. Use slow, easing transitions (e.g., duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]). Stagger list items in the services menu.
motion.hover: Images subtly scale up (scale-105) over 0.6s. Buttons shift background gracefully, text must remain high contrast.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio against background. Use text-shadow on hero image text if needed to pass APCA standards.
accessibility.data_testids: Strict naming convention required: data-testid='[page]-[component]-[action]'. Examples: 'home-hero-book-btn', 'booking-form-submit', 'menu-category-tabs'. ALL interactive elements must have this attribute.

media.3d_libraries: Avoid heavy 3D for this classic luxury aesthetic. Rely on high-quality 2D editorial imagery, masking, and Framer Motion parallax effects instead.
media.images: Large, high-resolution photography. Avoid styling with strong border-radius; use square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm) edges to maintain editorial sharpness.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'lucide-react' for crisp, minimal icons.
Build a hybrid fullstack app using React (JS), Tailwind, Shadcn UI and Python FastAPI for backend functionality.
Create a multi-page setup (Home, Services/Menu, Booking, Reviews, About, Contact) plus an Admin Panel.
Implement the Booking Form using Shadcn Calendar and Form components. The design should float elegantly over the page or sit in a spacious, padded container.
Implement the Reviews section dynamically, allowing users to submit 5-star ratings with a clean text area.

The Admin Dashboard must allow managing services, prices, rotating combo offers, viewing bookings, and moderating reviews. Use a denser, data-focused layout (High Density Grid) for the admin area, contrasting with the ultra-luxurious front-end.
Strictly follow the E1 persona: do not center-align everything, prioritize typography as an event, use generous spacing, and create asymmetry.
All interactive elements MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute.
Override default Shadcn styles to remove blocky cards and heavy shadows. Favor 1px delicate borders, flat designs, and organic color tints.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
